title: Young Boy Playing with Hose in Yard, 1959 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot from May 1959 depicting a young boy in his underwear/shorts and t-shirt standing outside in a suburban yard while holding a garden hose, spraying water onto the walkway. In the background, a classic mid-century house with lattice screening around the porch foundation and lush landscaping is visible. The date print 'MAY • 59' is clearly stamped along the left white border.
